sharedRules.description:
Each time an attack made with a **[LETHAL HITS]** weapon results in a **critical hit**, you can choose for that attack to automatically wound the target. 
***Designer's Note:** Choosing to automatically wound the target means that no **wound roll** is made for that attack. You may decide against this, as it means that attack cannot result in a **critical wound** and so cannot trigger other abilities such as [DEVASTATING WOUNDS].*
sharedRules.name: Lethal Hits

sharedRules.description: This ability always takes the form **[SUSTAINED HITS X]**. Each time an attack made with a **[SUSTAINED HITS]** weapon results in a critical hit, that attack scores X additional hits.
sharedRules.name: Sustained Hits

sharedRules.description: This ability always takes the form **[ANTI-X Y+]**. Each time an attack is made against a unit that has the X keyword with a weapon that has this ability, an unmodified wound roll of Y+ automatically scores a critical wound.
sharedRules.name: Anti

sharedRules.description: A model equipped with two **[TWIN-LINKED]** weapons of the same type can re-roll wound rolls.
sharedRules.name: Twin-linked

sharedRules.description: This ability always takes the form **[CLEAVE X]**. Add X additional attack dice for every five models in the target unit.
sharedRules.name: Cleave

sharedRules.description: Units containing one or more models with a **[CLOSE-QUARTERS]** weapon can shoot using close-quarters shooting.
sharedRules.name: Close-quarters
